options: Thanks, but I have already arranged them.

groups.transcript:
W: Good morning, Robert. Has the logistics company delivered our shipment of promotional brochures yet? The marketing expo starts tomorrow morning.
M: I checked with the front desk ten minutes ago, Brenda, and the delivery driver said the truck was caught in severe highway traffic. They expect to arrive by 2:00 P.M.
W: That gives us very little time to assemble the welcome packets before our booth opens.
M: Don't worry. I will ask two interns from human resources to help us organize and fold the materials as soon as the boxes arrive.
groups._speech: Questions 32 through 34 refer to the following conversation. Good morning, Robert. Has the logistics company delivered our shipment of promotional brochures yet? The marketing expo starts tomorrow morning. I checked with the front desk ten minutes ago, Brenda, and the delivery driver said the truck was caught in severe highway traffic. They expect to arrive by 2:00 P.M. That gives us very little time to assemble the welcome packets before our booth opens. Don't worry. I will ask two interns from human resources to help us organize and fold the materials as soon as the boxes arrive.

questions.content: What problem are the speakers discussing?
options: A shipment of promotional brochures is delayed.
An exhibition booth reservation was cancelled.
A presentation room is too small for attendees.
The budget for marketing materials was cut.
questions.explanation: Người phụ nữ hỏi về tài liệu quảng cáo và người nam giải thích xe tải giao hàng bị kẹt xe trên cao tốc đến 2h chiều mới tới → Chọn (A).

questions.content: When does the marketing expo begin?
options: At the end of this month
questions.explanation: Người phụ nữ nói: "The marketing expo starts tomorrow morning" → Chọn (B).

questions.content: How does the man propose to solve the schedule problem?
options: By printing new brochures in the office
By recruiting interns to help assemble packets
By contacting a different shipping vendor
questions.explanation: Người nam nói: "I will ask two interns from human resources to help us organize and fold the materials..." → Chọn (C).

groups._speech: Questions 71 through 73 refer to the following announcement. Attention all transit passengers traveling on the Silverline Express to Riverside Station. We regret to inform you that track maintenance between Oakfield and Pinecrest will temporarily suspend through-train service this weekend, starting Saturday at 6:00 A.M. Complimentary shuttle buses will operate outside Oakfield Station every ten minutes to transport passengers directly to Pinecrest. Standard train service will resume regular operations on Monday morning at 5:00 A.M. For real-time updates and alternative route suggestions, please visit our official website at www.metrorail.org or speak with a station agent.

questions.content: Where is this announcement most likely being broadcast?
questions.explanation: Thông báo nhắc tới "transit passengers", "Silverline Express", "track maintenance", "train service" → phát tại ga tàu hỏa (B).

questions.content: What will occur this weekend?
options: Train ticket fares will increase by five percent.
Train service between two stations will be temporarily suspended.
A new express route to Riverside will open.
Station parking lots will be closed for repaving.
questions.explanation: Thông báo nói: "track maintenance between Oakfield and Pinecrest will temporarily suspend through-train service this weekend" → Chọn (B).

questions.content: What alternative transportation is provided for passengers?
options: Free shuttle buses every ten minutes
questions.explanation: Thông báo nêu: "Complimentary shuttle buses will operate outside Oakfield Station every ten minutes..." → Chọn (A).

questions.content: All invoice receipts must be forwarded ------- to the accounts payable division to ensure prompt processing.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ thể bị động "must be forwarded" cần một trạng từ chỉ cách thức → chọn "promptly" (kịp thời, ngay lập tức).

questions.content: Ms. Kowalski demonstrated remarkable ------- when resolving the overseas client's shipping dispute.
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ "remarkable" cần một danh từ làm tân ngữ cho động từ "demonstrated" → chọn danh từ "professionalism" (tác phong chuyên nghiệp).

questions.content: Dr. Chen scheduled a virtual briefing to introduce ------- research proposal to the executive board.
questions.explanation: Đứng trước cụm danh từ "research proposal" cần một tính từ sở hữu bổ nghĩa → chọn "his" (của ông ấy).

questions.content: The company offered all staff members flexible hours ------- commuter traffic could be minimized during rush hour.
questions.explanation: Theo sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề có chủ ngữ và trợ động từ ("commuter traffic could be minimized...") biểu thị mục đích → chọn liên từ "so that" (để mà).

questions.content: Protective eyeglasses and earplugs are mandatory at all times ------- the manufacturing plant floor.
questions.explanation: Giới từ "throughout" đi kèm địa điểm mang nghĩa "trên toàn bộ khuôn viên / khắp mặt sàn nhà máy sản xuất".

MEMORANDUM
To: All Headquarters Personnel
From: Facilities & Operations Committee
Date: October 14
Subject: Scheduled Corporate Office Relocation

As previously communicated, our headquarters will transition to the modern Diamond Tower complex over the upcoming weekend. The relocation procedures will begin on Friday at 5:00 P.M. and continue [131] ------- Sunday evening.

All team members are requested to pack their personal desktop items and sensitive documents into the provided blue plastic crates before departing on Friday afternoon. [132] -------. Cardboard boxes and color-coded destination labels will be distributed by the facilities team starting tomorrow at 9:00 A.M.

Please note that our new facility features an automated optical card reader system. You will receive your new permanent access badge [133] ------- upon checking in with the security desk on Monday morning. We sincerely appreciate your patience and [134] ------- as we finalize this exciting corporate transition.

questions.content: Choose the best preposition to fill in blank [131].
questions.explanation: Cụm diễn tả hành động liên tục đến hết một mốc thời gian: "continue through Sunday evening" (tiếp diễn liên tục xuyên suốt đến hết tối Chủ Nhật).

questions.content: Choose the best sentence to fill in blank [132].
options: Please ensure all storage crates are securely locked and clearly labeled.
The cafeteria will launch a new seasonal lunch menu next month.
Annual health insurance renewal documents must be signed by noon.
Parking tickets can be validated at the front information counter.
questions.explanation: Câu trước nói về việc đóng gói đồ đạc vào thùng nhựa được cung cấp. Câu (A) nối tiếp dặn dò khóa và dán nhãn thùng chứa đồ một cách logic.

questions.content: Choose the best adverb to fill in blank [133].
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho cụm động từ "will receive your new permanent access badge" cần trạng từ → chọn "promptly" (ngay lập tức khi điểm danh sáng thứ Hai).

questions.content: Choose the best word form to fill in blank [134].
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ sở hữu "your" và đi liền sau danh từ "patience and..." cần một danh từ đồng vị → chọn "cooperation" (sự hợp tác).

groups.passage:
E-MAIL 1
From: Martin Vance <mvance@vancestrat.com>
To: Clara Higgins <chiggins@brightonhotel.com>
Date: November 4
Subject: Annual Leadership Retreat Reservation

Dear Ms. Higgins,
On behalf of Vance Strategy Group, I would like to reserve the Horizon Conference Room at the Brighton Hotel for our upcoming Executive Leadership Retreat on December 15. We anticipate 35 attendees and will require an audiovisual setup with dual projection screens and wireless lapel microphones. Additionally, we would like a hot buffet luncheon served at 12:30 P.M. Could you please send me a cost estimate and confirm availability?

Sincerely,
Martin Vance, Senior Partner

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

E-MAIL 2
From: Clara Higgins <chiggins@brightonhotel.com>
To: Martin Vance <mvance@vancestrat.com>
Date: November 5
Subject: RE: Annual Leadership Retreat Reservation

Dear Mr. Vance,
Thank you for choosing the Brighton Hotel! I am happy to confirm that the Horizon Conference Room is available on December 15. We have reserved the room from 8:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M. Our standard audiovisual conference package includes the dual projection screens and wireless microphones you requested.

However, our culinary team will be hosting a large holiday banquet in the main ballroom that afternoon. Therefore, luncheon service in the Horizon Suite will need to be served thirty minutes earlier, at 12:00 P.M. Please review the attached banquet contract and return a signed copy along with a 20% deposit by November 20 to secure the booking.

Warm regards,
Clara Higgins, Events Manager

questions.content: What is the purpose of Mr. Vance's email?
options: To reserve meeting space and catering for a company retreat
To file a formal complaint regarding faulty audiovisual equipment
To apply for a vacant event coordinator position
To cancel an existing conference room reservation
questions.explanation: Mr. Vance viết thư để đặt phòng Horizon và dịch vụ ăn uống tiệc trưa cho 35 người tham gia kỳ nghỉ dưỡng ban lãnh đạo → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What adjustment does Ms. Higgins propose regarding lunch?
options: Serving the luncheon thirty minutes earlier at 12:00 P.M.
Moving the dining area to an outdoor terrace
Replacing the hot buffet with cold sandwich platters
questions.explanation: Ms. Higgins giải thích khách sạn có tiệc lớn ở đại sảnh nên: "luncheon service in the Horizon Suite will need to be served thirty minutes earlier, at 12:00 P.M." → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What must Mr. Vance do by November 20?
options: Submit a signed contract and a 20% deposit
Confirm the dietary restrictions of all 35 attendees
Pay the full rental balance in advance
Inspect the Horizon Conference Room in person
questions.explanation: Đoạn cuối e-mail 2: "Please review the attached banquet contract and return a signed copy along with a 20% deposit by November 20..." → Chọn (A).
